'''House Arrel''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Kandor]], formerly a noble House of [[Malkier]] until the [[Fall of Malkier]] in {{ne|955}}.

The only known members of the House are [[Iselle Arrel]] and [[Edeyn Arrel]].
